DoD 8570 IAT-II compliant (e.g., Security+ CE, CASP+, CND, SSCP). Extended knowledge of modern operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux) and related security configuration. Knowledge of system security best practices and compliance standards including government Secure Technical Implementation Guidelines (STIGs). Familiarity with HCI, authentication protocols and C2 applications. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, adapt to changing requirements, and effectively communicate with POCs and customers. Able to support 24/7 operations (including support to exercises), when necessary. Able to follow instructions and work both independently and in a (distributed) team environment. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator or Red Hat Certified Systems Administrator (RHCSA). Relevant IT Certification (e.g., Citrix, Dell, HP, ITIL, Microsoft, Nutanix, VMware). Well-versed in Department of Defense (DoD) protocols, procedures, and regulations. Familiar with operating in classified environments. Prior Help Desk/software experience (e.g., Jira, Remedy, ServiceNow). Awareness or experience in ITIL framework and ITIL best practices. Additional Information Work Environment Fast-paced and deadline-oriented work environment. Potential for non-traditional working hours, including consecutive nights and weekends. Occasional travel to locations within the supported Area-of-Responsibility (AOR). Working at SOSi All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.
